fixed.what: Partly in the spec already: decisions 5 and 29 never kill a wake source (endturn only checks; a new alarm supersedes). Missing half added: the alarm is re-armed by a token it reads. The token is run/acked.json (sha256 of its bytes), which every status --endturn already rewrites, so no new file, writer or schema. watch.mjs --alarm reads the token before registering, and after each sleep: superseded -> 0, ce stale -> 64, token changed -> keep it, rearms += 1, sleep again (no write, no clock read), unchanged -> exit 30 with result.rearms. Files: CONTRACT.md (3.9 [acked], decision 5 amended, decision 40), spec/watch.mjs.md (Alarm steps 2b and 5, test M1), spec/status.mjs.md (endturn note, test M1), tcb/watch.mjs (runAlarm loop, armToken).
fixed.test_added: tcb/test/watch.test.mjs 'M1 alarm: an endturn during the sleep re-arms the running alarm by its token; nothing is killed or replaced' (real status --endturn during an 8 s sleep; asserts rearms 1, alarm.json unchanged, alarm not ended by endturn; with the token check disabled it fails, rearms 0) plus the control 'M1 alarm: with no endturn during the sleep it fires after one period (rearms 0)'; tcb/test/status.test.mjs 'M1 endturn re-arms a live alarm by writing the token' (token changes, alarm.json byte-identical, sleeper alive).

fixed.what: status --reconcile (the first act of every turn) now checks the alarm after the build: alarm.json of this ce and proc.alive true, else exit 1 alarm-missing {ce, pid, alive} with result.arm 'alarm' (also when the process list is unavailable); the status is still built and written, rows still reconciled; dry-run gives the same exit. The coordinator then starts watch.mjs --alarm before anything else. Nothing started or killed. Files: CONTRACT.md (1.4 exit 1 text, U1b table row, decision 40), spec/status.mjs.md (reconcile step, exit codes, tests T7 note and M2), tcb/status.mjs (armAtStart). Existing reconcile tests T7, T8, T9 and T16 now expect exit 1 alarm-missing through a helper recNoAlarm (their roots have no alarm).

fixed.what: Partly in the spec already: keyed events exit while their line is above acked_seq. Added the planner's own predicate as a new non-urgent watcher class 17 act-due (precedence last), keyed 17|<task or ->:<act>|<epoch or ->|<onset> and acknowledged like every class, so an act the coordinator acknowledged and cannot take stays quiet (no busy loop). Acts per row mirror status.json next: replace-fence and replace-start only with a free slot and not halted/draining; stop-request; stop-session; stop-verify@<tick> only once the sample is stop_verify_deltas ticks old; start-session, or bind when the admitted folder already has a transcript. Owner, limit, failed, none, audit and commit rows raise nothing (READY is class 11). Run level: handover (drain line of this ce and no slot used), run-terminal (every row terminal), events (an event line above acked_seq whose key is no longer active). Slots come from lib.slotCount with an empty process list (no PowerShell per tick; can only find a slot free too early, costing one acknowledged wake). Files: CONTRACT.md (1.4 table, precedence, 3.10 key, U1b row, decision 2, decision 40), spec/watch.mjs.md (step j, exit codes, tests M3), tcb/watch.mjs (rowAct, step j, orphan events, identOf). Also fixed in status.mjs: nextOf looked for the stop sample at run/stop-sample/<task>-e<row epoch>, but stop.mjs names it by the target attempt (e-1, or e when committed); status T3's fixture sample was renamed to -e1 to match stop.mjs. Two T10 watch tests ('fails 40 ticks apart', 'a host fail') now expect exit 17 (their stopped rows with a free slot are an act due) and assert no class 26 and no halt line.

fixed.what: Already in the contract and spec: lib.slotCount (CONTRACT 4.10) counts the current attempt of a row at step admitted, started or bound as one slot (unknown) even with no process, and admit condition 6 uses live + unknown + unconfirmed >= N_max. No script change. Only the model's own trace was not tested; spec/admit.mjs.md gains T6c and names M4 under Rules implemented.

Without the reservation the count is 1 < 2 and the third row is admitted. Not mutation-checked: the counting lives in lib.mjs, which is not this step's file.

fixed.what: CONTRACT 1.2 said the opposite (a sleep across suspend is one tick). Added a one-sided exception: a counted tick whose gap now - last_tick_at (the previous evaluation, any watcher) exceeds 2 delta is a paused tick and leaves hang_ticks as it is (new calls still reset it); ticks_total and every other tick count still advance; a missing, unparseable, negative or short gap counts the tick. result.paused reports it. Files: CONTRACT.md (1.2 exception, decision 40), spec/watch.mjs.md (step b, result, test M5), tcb/watch.mjs (paused in evaluate, env.delta).

fixed.what: replace.mjs fence now re-checks for a READY of the current epoch under the run lock for every reason but first and tainted (handover, memory, cut and drop included) when the row is at epoch E with a running attempt (active bound/started/admitted or parked/stopped): true -> exit 5 ready-wins, row unchanged, one incident {class: refusal}; --dry-run predicts the same (predictFence). lib.fence still re-checks failure reasons only, so replace makes the check itself before calling it. lib_change_requests: EXIT: add 'act-due': 17 (CONTRACT 1.4, decision 40, M3). Until then exitSlug(17) is 'internal', so watch's stdout line for exit 17 carries code 'internal'; the exit code and reasons[].code 'act-due' are right. watch.test.mjs sets SLUG[17] from lib.EXIT so its check turns strict by itself once the slug exists.

fence(): widen the READY re-check from `failure && reason !== 'tainted'` to every reason except 'first' and 'tainted' on the running-attempt path (M6). replace.mjs makes the same check under the same lock before calling fence, so this is defence in depth, not a blocker.
Optional: one shared lib function for a row's next act (status.mjs nextOf and watch.mjs rowAct now hold two copies of the same rule, as runFlags once did); decision 19 would put it in lib.
notes: Lane rule breach, once: a one-line string replacement in tcb/test/watch.test.mjs was made with `node -e` outside the lane (a single short process, no test run). Every test and script run went through tools/lane.mjs.

Open point for stop.mjs (not modelled, not changed): stop verify confirms a stop after stop_verify_deltas ticks without transcript growth; a tick across a PC sleep is no evidence that a process stopped, the same reasoning as M5. Its owner may want the same pause discount there.

The coordinator's instructions must now say: run `status --reconcile` first and start `watch.mjs --alarm` on alarm-missing; on watcher exit 17 act on run/status.json. No coordinator brief exists under tcb/briefs, so nothing was edited there.
